
# Load dataset

```{r,warning=FALSE}
pop=readxl::read_xlsx("C:\\Users\\P095206\\OneDrive - Amsterdam UMC\\Shared material with Elia\\PhD\\Project 5 - Simulation study in SATs\\Data\\population_dur.xlsx")
```

Create dftrial

```{r}
# divide treated and untreated
trt=pop %>% 
  filter(trt==1) %>% 
  select(id,event,timedays,duration,timedaystrt,calendar)
```

# Idea

Double all patients

```{r}
counter=rbind(trt,trt) %>% 
  arrange(id) %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(timec=ifelse(row_number()==1,timedaystrt,timedays-duration),
         trtc=ifelse(row_number()==1,1,0),
         eventc=ifelse(timec>=365,0,1),
         timec=ifelse(timec>=365,365,timec)
         ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(id,eventc,trtc,timec,calendar)
```

Model

```{r}
model=coxph(Surv(timec,eventc)~trtc+calendar,counter)
summary(model)
```

# Loop

## 20

```{r}
set.seed(03111963)
beta=c(); ntrt=c()
for (ntrti in seq(20,50,10)){  
  for (i in 1:1e3){
    # sample thirty random patients
    trti=trt[sample(1:nrow(trt),ntrti),]
    # double those patients
    dftrti=rbind(trti,trti)
    # create df value
    dfmodel=dftrti %>% 
      arrange(id) %>% 
      group_by(id) %>% 
      mutate(timec=ifelse(row_number()==1,timedaystrt,timedays-duration),
           trtc=ifelse(row_number()==1,1,0),
           eventc=ifelse(timec>=365,0,1),
           timec=ifelse(timec>=365,365,timec)) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      select(id,event,trtc,timec)
    # run model on doubled dataset
    modeli=coxph(Surv(timec,event)~trtc,dfmodel)
    # store beta
    beta=c(beta,modeli$coefficients)
    ntrt=c(ntrt,ntrti)
    # where we at?
    if (i %in% seq(100,10000,100)){print(paste("Combination: ","i=",i,";"," k=",ntrti,sep=""))}
  }
}
```

Distribution

```{r}
# bind together
dftrue=data.frame(betas=beta,ntrts=paste("n=",ntrt,sep=""))
# create median database
med_df=dftrue %>%
  group_by(ntrts) %>%
  summarise(median=median(betas, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd=sd(betas, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
# plot
ggplot(dftrue, aes(x = betas)) +
  geom_histogram(col = "black", fill = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ntrts) +
  geom_vline(data=med_df,
             aes(xintercept=median),
             linetype="dashed",
             colour="red") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
